options.label: Bike taxi

instructions: Take a bike taxi (13.0 km) to Kakkanad. Book in a ride-hailing app; pickup wait is assumed.

options.label: Bus

instructions: Walk 380 m to Subash Park stop.

costEstimate.basis: Project fare rule: ₹10 up to 1 km, then ₹8 for each further (started) km

instructions: Board the bus towards Kakkanad at Subash Park.
Ride 22 stops and get off at Kunnumpuram.
Departure time is an estimate (assumed 10-min average wait).

assumptions: Bus feed headways are a uniform 60-minute placeholder; an assumed 20-minute headway (10-minute expected wait) is used instead.
Bus fare is an approximate range, not a quote.
warnings: Bus routes come from 2022–23 community data and may have changed.
